messages:
Priya: @channel Friday evening idea — trivia + craft beer tasting at The Tasting Room (8pm), then ramen at Shio (10pm). Who's in? :beers: :ramen:
Alex: love it. Count me in. Prefer earlier start (7:30) if folks ok?
Mateo: In. 8pm fine for me. Can we do a non-alcoholic option for Pjea?
Lina: I'll come! Maybe organize teams? 4 people per team?
Ben: I'm down. Would pay for ticket in advance if needed.
Priya: Good call on teams. How about 3 rounds + lightning round. Team size 3-4 — vote with emoji
Priya: Options:
- 7:30 start
- 8:00 start
React with :one: for 7:30, :two: for 8:00
Alex: :one:
Mateo: :two:
Lina: :one:
Ben: :one:
Priya: Looks like 7:30 wins. I'll book a table for 8 (they can take early) and rack up quiz tickets. Anyone want me to add you to the reservation?
Alex: Add me pls
Lina: Add me
Mateo: Not me, I'll swing by around 7:45
Ben: Add Ben
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Trivia & Beer" Friday 19:30 — RSVP by Thursday 17:00. Use /rsvp to confirm.
Priya: Sweet. Also quick ramen preference? Tonkotsu or Shoyu?
Lina: Tonkotsu :yum:
Mateo: Shoyu
Alex: Tonkotsu
Ben: Shoyu
Priya: Noted. Thanks all :heart:
